prompts: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: landscape illustration for the Green Loom UX portfolio case study. Create a polished editorial illustration, 3:2 landscape, off-white background, dark charcoal labels, forest green and sage accents, crisp fine ink linework with softly shaded tangible objects. Generous space, legible large sans-serif text. Visually engaging through illustrated objects, not a grid of boring text boxes. No disclaimer, no watermark, no decorative cannabis leaves, no invented results, no large headline repeating the surrounding page heading. Primary request: Explain the retail catalog model through one concrete sample product. Across the upper middle, illustrate a peach chew product identity sheet labelled 'Product' and 'Shared identity', then a small retail carton labelled 'Variant' and 'Sellable package', then a store shelf tag labelled 'Listing' and 'Store offer'. Connect them left to right with thin green arrows. Beneath, show two distinct supporting objects: a lab certificate labelled 'Lab Result' and 'Testing evidence', connected with a fine line to the package; and a small stack of cartons with a counter labelled 'Inventory' and 'Stock at a store', connected to the listing. Exactly five primary labels: Product, Variant, Listing, Lab Result, Inventory. Keep the lab certificate separate from the product sheet. Use 'Peach Orchard Chew' as the sample identity. Show relationships without extra technical cardinality notation. All five objects have distinct silhouettes; diagram must be understandable at a glance.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: landscape illustration for the Green Loom UX portfolio case study. Create a polished editorial illustration, 3:2 landscape, off-white background, dark charcoal labels, forest green and sage accents, crisp fine ink linework with softly shaded tangible objects. Generous space, legible large sans-serif text. Visually engaging through illustrated objects, not a grid of boring text boxes. No disclaimer, no watermark, no decorative cannabis leaves, no invented results, no large headline repeating the surrounding page heading. Primary request: Visualize two paths through the same retail catalog. Two balanced illustrated scenes side by side, with short labels above each: 'First publication' left and 'Returning operator' right. Left shows an operator at a desktop with a simple guided setup screen, an illustrated product carton and lab certificate nearby. Three small linked milestones beneath: 'Add product', 'Review evidence', 'Check readiness'. Right shows the same operator using a focused catalog workspace, a highlighted stock field and shelf carton. Three short task labels beneath: 'Find the item', 'Update stock', 'See availability'. Use restrained green arrows to show left path sequential and right path direct. At bottom center a shared small linked-record motif labelled 'Same catalog. Different paths.' No stopwatch, no numerical time savings, no success claims. The difference is amount of guidance, not different underlying records. Minimal interface details, clear engaging illustration.

Primary request: Explain a portable product-data schema and a separate Georgia hemp profile through a clean illustrated document system. Left two-thirds shows five distinct document sheets arranged in a neat open fan, each with a simple relevant illustration and exact prominent labels: 'Product', 'Package', 'LabResult', 'Label', 'Party'. Above this group write 'Shared core'. Right third shows a separate translucent sage overlay sheet labelled 'Georgia hemp profile', containing four short entries 'Product forms', 'Testing evidence', 'Labeling', 'Potency constraints'. Use one slim connector from the separate profile sheet toward the core documents and a small bottom label 'Local rules applied to shared data'. Make it unmistakable that the profile is separate from the core, not a sixth core document or a replacement. Illustrated papers and restrained connector, no bullet-heavy slide, no legal approval stamp, no compliance claims, no map needed.
edits: Edit this catalog-model illustration. Preserve the five main labels, all objects, layout, arrows, color and illustration quality. Simplify the sample product and documents: remove all THC/potency dosages, health/effect claims, pass results, lab signatures, lab names, dates, approval seals, and invented brand names. Product sheet contains only 'Peach Orchard Chew', 'Form: Chew', 'Flavor: Peach' with remaining fine text replaced by subtle neutral placeholder lines. Carton contains only 'Peach Orchard Chew' and '10 chews'; remove Cannabis-infused text and any side-panel claims. Store tag contains only 'Peach Orchard Chew', '10 count', and '$28.00' as sample price. Lab sheet contains only 'Certificate of Analysis' and neutral gray table lines, no numerical test results or approval seal. Inventory counter '24 in stock' stays. Main labels Product, Variant, Listing, Lab Result, Inventory and their subtitles stay identical. No disclaimers. No cannabis leaf icon.

Edit only the sample product details in this two-path illustration. Preserve the operator, composition, all main headings, milestone labels, bottom shared-catalog motif, palette, screen layout and illustration style. All cartons and the catalog screen should depict 'Peach Orchard Chew' and 'Chews' instead of 'Botanical Blend', 'Pre-rolls' or 'Pre-rolls 1g'. This is an edible chew product, no flower or pre-rolls. Remove invented compliance approval seals from the certificate; keep a plain certificate illustration with 'Certificate of Analysis' and neutral document lines. Keep the six milestone labels and bottom 'Same catalog. Different paths.' unchanged.
